note: 2026 prize winners used as a fixed test set. Names, prizes and institutions come from public announcements (Simons Foundation for the Fields Medals, NobelPrize.org coverage for the Nobel Prizes). ORCID iDs and OpenAlex ids are not stored here on purpose: scripts/laureate_eval.py looks them up on each run and records what it found. Pin a verified id below (openalex_id / orcid) to override the lookup. Put a CV or profile PDF at eval/cvs/<id>.pdf to also run the resume path for that person. Economics (announced Oct 12) is not in the list yet.
